verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, cost, and mechanics. Preserve unresolved stamina/version-sensitive fields as null.
research_scope: Final Blow — Strike Super Skill Shop acquisition and Vegeta variant research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository exact-name coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Final Blow was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike; the separate Final Blow (SSGSSE) implementation is retained as a documented variant of the same named skill rather than a duplicate identity.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Final Blow as a Strike Super Attack.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation lists the TP Medal Shop as the Future Warrior acquisition route. Independent Dragon Ball documentation also states that the Future Warrior can purchase Final Blow from the Conton City Skill Shop; the repository records the current TP Medal Shop listing while retaining the broader Skill Shop wording in source context.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented acquisition route is shop purchase rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed sources do not establish a reliable canonical stamina value.

records.name: Final Blow
records.character_source: Vegeta / SSGSS Vegeta / SSGSS Vegeta (Evolved) / SS3 Vegeta (DAIMA) / Vegeta (Super Saiyan 4) customizable partner
records.skill_description: A fast forward dash/teleport followed by a powerful single punch that launches the opponent away.
records.mechanics_notes: The standard Final Blow rapidly closes distance and punches the opponent upward before knockback. The SSGSS Vegeta (Evolved) version can appear directly in front of the target regardless of starting distance, while remaining part of the same named skill family. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation lists TP Medal Shop as the acquisition route. Independent Dragon Ball documentation describes the Future Warrior purchasing Final Blow from the Conton City Skill Shop; this terminology difference is retained as source context rather than treated as a second skill identity.
records.pve_notes: Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Fast single-hit Strike Super with strong approach/teleport behavior. Detailed matchup and frame behavior remains version-sensitive.
